newsitem.title: USA: UAL exchange offer closes, shares to trade.
newsitem.headline: UAL exchange offer closes, shares to trade.

text.p: UAL Corp completed an offer on December 20 to exchange newly established 13.25 percent Trust Originated Preferred Securities (TOPrS) for all of its outstanding depositary shares of 12.25 percent UAL Corp Series B preferred stock, the company said Monday.

As a result of the exchange offer, a total of 2,999,804 depositary shares, representing 47.9 percent of the outstanding issue, were tendered. Of these, 106,738 were tendered via notice of guaranteed delivery.
Each depositary share represents 1/1,000 of a share of the 12.25 percent UAL Corp Series B preferred stock.
The TOPrS are to be issued by UAL Corp Capital Trust I, a Delaware statutory business trust that exists solely as a finance vehicle for UAL Corp.
UAL Corp is a holding company whose primary subsidiary is United Airlines Inc.

The securities are expected to begin trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "UAL Pr T" on December 31, 1996. At that time, there will be 3,266,977 outstanding depositary shares not owned by UAL.
